stage0024_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Not bad, Kashim!
　And your friend and the little lady too!」

stage0024_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ガウルン$$!
　Why are you here!?」

stage0024_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This $$マーティアル$$'s the god of war, right?
　Sounds perfect for me, don't you think?」

stage0024_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't think you're the type to believe in gods!」

stage0024_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's how it is, $n.
　Once humans gain a god as
　their patron, any act is justified」

stage0024_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「A god may save humanity,
　but it could just as easily damn it to darkness」

stage0024_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's right.
　God and devil are alike in this:
　both hold power beyond human ken」

stage0024_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「And so, man aims to become a god...」

stage0024_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$宗介$$
「If we strike from outside,
　he'll have an easier time in there!」

stage0024_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「All right, Kashim!
　Shall we go for round two!」

stage0024_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Multiple units launching from the temple confirmed!」

stage0024_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Some of those ATs and ASes are new to me...」

stage0024_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Those ATs are the $$エルドスピーネ$$ used
　by the $$マーティアル$$ Order」

stage0024_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「It looks like the AT that took $$フィアナ$$.」

stage0024_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「The AS is a Zy-98, called the Shadow.
　I heard it was still in development,
　yet here it is, already in combat...」

stage0024_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So the fact they're fighting side by side means...」

stage0024_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Yes.
　This confirms that the $$マーティアル$$ Order
　has been behind our battles all along」

stage0024_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then I suppose there's no need to hold back?」

stage0024_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ラム$$
「We've recovered Sgt. Sagara and the others!
　$$キリコ$$ still appears to be inside the temple!」

stage0024_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Launch all units!
　We're intercepting the $$マーティアル$$ Order!」

stage0024_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Skull Leader to all units!
　As you heard, we're covering $$キリコ$$!」

stage0024_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Stay alert, everyone.
　The new AS and $$マーティアル$$'s ATs
　have power beyond anything we've faced!」

stage0024_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That guy...!
　The monster from Hanka Autonomous Region!」

stage0024_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$マオ$$
「To think he survived that explosion...!」

stage0024_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Come on, let's have some fun!
　Let's dedicate our fight to $$マーティアル$$'s so-called god!」

stage0024_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「A prolonged battle favors them.
　Operation time limit: six minutes」

stage0024_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$クラン$$
「No way...!
　You fell back without saving $$フィアナ$$!」

stage0024_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「What on earth happened in that temple...?」

stage0024_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Him again... going to the temple in an AT this time!」

stage0024_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Please be careful!
　Something's coming out of the temple!」

stage0024_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$マオ$$
「The AT that took $$フィアナ$$!」

stage0024_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「The Shield of Order graces us, huh.
　Guess the $$マーティアル$$ lot are awfully
　keen on their 'Untouchable'」

stage0024_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Du Oste Owagura Kure Yashidiro
　Gratzi Mito Momendari...」

stage0024_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Decided fighting bare-handed
　wasn't getting anywhere? Wise, $$キリコ$$」

stage0024_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「But defeating you in an AT is my
　true purpose! I'll show you the $$ネクスタント$$'s power!」

stage0024_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Unidentified units approaching this area confirmed!」

stage0024_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$n
「Is that the bat that came with the $$ジェニオン$$!」

stage0024_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But wasn't that thing swept into this world
　by a dimensional tremor accident...!」

stage0024_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That Unknown,
　looks like it's coming for us!」

stage0024_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$クラン$$
「Then is that a $$マーティアル$$ unit!?」

stage0024_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Save the questions for later!
　Since the Unknown is unmanned,
　we've got no choice but to fight!」

stage0024_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I don't know who they are,
　but if they keep the others busy,
　I can focus on my fight with $$キリコ$$...!」

stage0024_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Here I come, $$キリコ$$...!
　I'll be the one to defeat you!」

stage0024_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$キャシー$$
「But what about $$フィアナ$$...」

stage0024_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Order all units to return.
　Staying here is too dangerous」

stage0024_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Operation time's passed six minutes...!」

stage0024_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It can't be helped...
　Order all units to return」

stage0024_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「What's wrong, Kashim?
　Tucking your tail and running?」

stage0024_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Don't take the bait, Sgt. Sagara」

stage0024_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$$キリコ$$, quit being reckless!」

stage0024_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I won't let you go!」

stage0024_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「No need to worry.
　$$キリコ$$ got out.」

stage0024_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Gah...! The aux-brain kicked in...
　But this isn't a real victory...!」

stage0024_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Can you hear me, $$キリコ$$!
　The $$マーティアル$$ Order has the girl!」

stage0024_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「If you want her back, come to me!
　We'll settle today's score then!」

stage0024_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it!
　Have they already sent $$フィアナ$$ off somewhere!?」

stage0024_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$キャシー$$
「The ground forces recovered $$キリコ$$!」

stage0024_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, fall back!
　Hurry!」

stage0024_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Untouchable, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$...
　I will settle this, no matter what.」

stage0024_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「But that mysterious unit...
　Why did it cover for us...」

stage0024_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Untouchable, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$...
　I will settle this, no matter what.」

stage0024_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「But that mysterious unit...
　Why did it cover for us...」

stage0024_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Tch...!
　Prototype toys sure give a lot of trouble!」

stage0024_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$宗介$$
「I won't let you escape, $$ガウルン$$!」

stage0024_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't be in such a rush, Kashim.
　The game's only just gotten started.」

stage0024_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$カリーニン$$
（That man...
　So he really does have some backing...）

stage0024_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Gah...! Not here, of all places!」

stage0024_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$!
　Why won't you kill me!?」

stage0024_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no reason to kill you.」

stage0024_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I was trying to take your life!」

stage0024_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$キリコ$$
「...The fight's decided.
　There's no need for more.」

stage0024_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Where do you think... you're going!?」

stage0024_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$$キリコ$$, quit being reckless!」

stage0024_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I won't let you go, $$キリコ$$!」

stage0024_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「No need to worry.
　That man got out.」

stage0024_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Gah...! The aux-brain kicked in...
　But this isn't a real victory...!」

stage0024_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Can you hear me, $$キリコ$$!
　The $$マーティアル$$ Order has the girl!」

stage0024_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「If you want her back, come to me!
　We'll settle today's score then!」

stage0024_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it!
　Have they already sent $$フィアナ$$ off somewhere!?」

stage0024_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$キャシー$$
「The ground forces recovered $$キリコ$$!」

stage0024_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Now that we know she isn't here,
　we'll hit the enemy fast and pull out.」

stage0024_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ガウルン$$!
　What's standing behind you!?」

stage0024_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Come on now... you think there's a mercenary
　who'd blab about his sponsor?」

stage0024_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「For now, I'm fighting for $$マーティアル$$'s god!
　'Might brings harmony... war itself is peace!'」

stage0024_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That's it, Kashim!
　Get angry, hate! Go back to who you were!」

stage0024_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Crushing that is exactly what I want!
　Kaaashiiim!」

stage0024_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This makes me happy, little $$キリコ$$.
　Getting to go at it for real again!」

stage0024_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I don't have time for you.」

stage0024_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't be so cold!
　Sorry to $$マーティアル$$'s big sister, but
　you're still my prey, you know!」

stage0024_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll repay the debt from Hanka, war profiteer!」

stage0024_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Look who's talking, private military provider!
　You and I aren't so different!」

stage0024_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't lump us together with someone
　who treats war as an outlet for desire!」

stage0024_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「What's wrong, boy?
　Fancy machine and all, but
　can't lay a hand on me?」

stage0024_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't bring a babysitter to the battlefield, amateur!」

stage0024_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$n
「If that amateur takes you down,
　you won't get to run your mouth again!」

stage0024_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You crack me up!
　I'll grant you've got the guts of a pro, at least!」

stage0024_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「A mercenary of this so-called $$ミスリル$$...!
　I'll test if you're worthy to face me!」

stage0024_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$宗介$$
「No need for that.
　To me, you're just one more enemy
　I've met on the battlefield...!」

stage0024_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I've been waiting for this, $$キリコ$$!
　Defeating you will prove the $$ネクスタント$$'s power!」

stage0024_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Move.
　I don't have time for you.」

stage0024_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「You disappoint me...!
　Why does someone called an abnormal
　obsess over a mere woman!?」

stage0024_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I don't need to explain to you.」

stage0024_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Fine, then...!
　If you want to see her, fight me!」

stage0024_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
Teitania
「I am $$テイタニア・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$...!
　$$マーティアル$$'s Shield of Order,
　the one who will defeat the Untouchable!」

stage0024_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$アルト$$
「This is what's getting in $$キリコ$$'s way!」

stage0024_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I bear no personal grudge, but
　he and I are fated to fight!」

stage0024_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「And anyone who interferes with that fight
　I will eliminate, all of them!」

stage0024_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アルト$$
「As if I'd go along with your one-sided fate!
　I'll take his place instead of $$キリコ$$!」

stage0024_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「You're a little useful, but not enough!
　Relying on your machine's performance!?」

stage0024_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$n
「I fight to win!
　I'll use any means necessary for that!」

stage0024_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Silence!
　I cannot lose
　to someone who says such things so lightly!」

stage0024_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（$$マーティアル$$... the god of war...）

stage0024_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（The world may never change, $$ルルーシュ$$...）

stage0024_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$n
「What are these guys...!?
　Are they backing up $$マーティアル$$!?」

stage0024_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　Focus on defeating the enemy right now!」

stage0024_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$n
「Don't tell me these guys...
　have secured a route to invade this world!」
